chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who is found slain in a village or between two villages. He said: “The distance between them is measured, and whichever of them is nearer is held liable.”

key_terms.أَقْرَبَ: nearer; the closer of the two locations
key_terms.الْقَرْيَةِ: the village in which the body is found or near which the case is considered
key_terms.بَيْنَ قَرْيَتَيْنِ: between two villages; a location of disputed proximity
key_terms.ضُمِّنَتْ: is held liable; responsibility for compensation is assigned
key_terms.قَتِيلًا: a slain person; someone found killed
key_terms.يُقَاسُ: it is measured; the relevant distances are assessed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a murdered person is found between two villages and the killer is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a slain person whose killer is unknown and who is found in or between villages. The Imam عليه السلام states that liability is assigned based on proximity, with the nearer village being held responsible.
